source.notes: in: seed = ThreadSafeRandom's new System.Random(seed); now = Time.GetUnixTime(); use_timestamp = the cloak's PropertyFloat.UseTimestamp (null = unset); total_xp/base_xp (PropertyInt64.ItemTotalXp/ItemBaseXp), max_level (PropertyInt.ItemMaxLevel), style (PropertyInt.ItemXpStyle), weave (PropertyInt.CloakWeaveProc), each null = unset; pct = damage_percent; custom = use_cloak_proc_custom_scale, with cooldown/max_base/plateau = cloak_cooldown_seconds/cloak_max_proc_base/cloak_max_proc_damage_percentage when custom. out = [result, the cloak's UseTimestamp after (null = unset), ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) drawn after the call].
